name: Chart Suggestion
description: Proposes suitable chart types for the selected columns
emptyStateNoSelection: Select one or more columns in the worksheet and click "Suggest chart" in the toolbar. We will propose suitable chart types based on the column roles.
emptyStateNoMatch: No chart type matches the current selection. Try another combination — for example one continuous and one categorical column.
whenToUse: You have columns of a worksheet and need to know which chart fits their roles — a ranked list with a preview, from which the chosen chart opens as a module of its own.

axis.previewUnavailable: Preview for "{type}" is not available yet.

charts.imrRowOrder: I-MR chart (row order as time axis)

notes.matrixTruncated: Only the first {shown} of {total} columns are shown in the matrix.
notes.transformedImrReason: Skewed distribution, transformation recommended: the values are clearly right-skewed and all positive. An I-MR chart on the raw data would raise too many false alarms above the mean and too few below.

invariants.oneSheet: The columns must come from the same sheet.
invariants.distinct: Each column may be chosen only once.
